This '''certain''' [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] was the elected president of a meeting of Weequays. The purpose of the meeting was to discover the [[Dannik Jerriko|unknown]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who had been terrorizing the hallways of [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. The Weequay president was killed during the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]] when [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Khetanna/Legends|sail barge]] exploded.
